data.gender_notes: Karamat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Karamat refers to the miraculous acts performed by the Awliya Allah (Friends of God) in Islam. It symbolizes the blessings and favors of Allah. The name Karamat carries the meaning “Miracles of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Karamat usually hope their child will grow to embody miracles of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karamat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
